title: claude-agy executor report
description: The final report an Antigravity agent returns to Claude Code through claude-agy. agy enforces it with --json-schema and returns it as the result's structured_output.

status.description: done: the task is complete. blocked: something outside your control stopped you; list it in blockers. failed: you tried, but could not complete the task.

summary.description: One to three sentences: what you did and how it ended.

details.description: Findings, answers or a plan the task asked for. Empty if there are none.

changes.description: Every file you created, edited or deleted.

change.description: What changed, in a few words.

verification.description: Every check you ran, such as tests, a build or a linter, and its result.

output.description: The lines of output that show the result, such as the test summary.

assumptions.description: Assumptions you made where the task was silent.

remaining.description: Work the task asked for that is not done.

blockers.description: What stopped you. At least one entry when status is blocked or failed.

kind.description: permission: an action was denied or needs approval. missing_tool: a command, program, package, service or tool is not available. needs_input: the task is ambiguous or contradictory, or lacks a file, credential or decision. out_of_scope: finishing needs changes the task rules out. environment: the network, sandbox, disk or a service is broken. task_failed: you tried, but cannot meet the acceptance criteria.

detail.description: What happened, with the exact error message if there was one.

target.description: The command, file, tool, package or URL involved. Empty if none.
